name: Enterprise Contract, Obligation and SLA
constraints: WM-ECO-006 masters agreement identity, party positions and execution-time occupancy, formation, immutable executed expressions, clause work identifiers, amendments, termination, survival and contract-record governance.

WM-XCT-029 masters each duty's modality, obligor, obligee and enforcer roles, conditions, due basis, fulfilment criteria and progress, outstanding quantity, evidence status, per-duty dispute, breach, cure, excuse, waiver and consequences.
A duty cites stable clause work ID plus exact expression ID and locator; the cited executed expression governs, any narrative is non-normative and legacy free-text obligation fields are alias-only.

WM-ECO-006 stores no live duty state, quantities, evidence status or per-duty dispute; contract-level avoidance, termination, fundamental-breach classification and exclusive-remedy election reference WM-XCT-029 determinations without restating them.

Every executed expression is immutable with digest, signature package and validation report; an amendment is a new executed child instrument producing a successor expression while signed predecessors and redirects remain resolvable.
A conformed contract text is a derived projection with its own identifier and never overwrites an executed expression.
Execution-time party occupancy is frozen on WM-ECO-006; current obligor is a WM-XCT-029 role binding to the contract position and current occupant.

Party-change operations are typed: amendment keeps positions and changes terms; assignment or transfer with consent continues the agreement and retains residual liability unless explicit discharge is recorded; novation is release-and-substitute with successor links; a new agreement receives a new identity plus predecessor link.
Partial fulfilment accumulates accepted quantity and preserves outstanding quantity as-of; acceptance with reservation, unconditional discharge and provisional disputed performance remain distinct.

Partial fulfilment accumulates accepted quantity and preserves outstanding quantity as-of; obligee acceptance, acceptance-with-reservation and unconditional discharge are distinct WM-XCT-029 legal-act states, subject to the acceptance/evidence mastership hold.

WM-XCT-029 masters obligee acceptance acts and evidence-status binding; WM-XCT-028 is the named evidence-item seam for identity, digest, custody, contest and withdrawal, while payload stays with its document or observation owner; one item and digest chain supports distinct attestation and acceptance roles and survives revocation.

A contractual SLA duty requires executed clause locator, obligee, enforcing party, threshold and unit, measurement window, method, conformity assessor and typed consequence; metric identifier, window and method remain inline while WM-SFT-016 is unavailable.

The profile has no dependency on WM-SFT-016; if that model is later completed it may be referenced for SLI, target, observation and error-budget semantics but cannot own contractual standing, remedy or breach.

Service credits are typed WM-XCT-029 consequences with regime-qualified class remedy, liquidated-damages, penalty, price-adjustment or other; this profile makes no jurisdictional enforceability conclusion.
Duty dispute remains WM-XCT-029-owned while forum, claim file and adjudication remain external case-model concerns; contested performance blocks automatic disposition.
Contract Amendment, Fulfilment Evidence and SLA have no independent aggregate identity in this contour and create no new catalogue or runtime identifier.
At most one exclusive-remedy election is effective for one contractual claim and instant; later election appends a superseding contract-level event.
A conformed projection never becomes an executed expression and cannot authorize duty change.
Incorporating an internal target requires a new executed contract or amendment expression before a contractual SLA duty can be derived.
holds: WM-ECO-006 and WM-XCT-029 remain non-canonical reviewable drafts and the profile cannot promote ahead of them.
The field-level crosswalk for obligation, breach/remedy, amendment and evidence overlap is not ratified in the base contracts.
Delegation and third-party-performance typing is missing from WM-ECO-006 change events.
Reserved acceptance versus unconditional discharge and recomputation after revoked evidence require ratified semantics.
Acceptance and evidence mastership, including the WM-XCT-028 seam, is unratified.
SLA required-field floor and inline measurement semantics remain unratified while WM-SFT-016 is a stub.
Party-change typology for assignment, discharge, novation and predecessor/successor links remains unratified.
WM-SFT-016 remains an uninstalled boundary-review stub and is reference-only.
Writing-form rules, service-credit classification, implied duties, set-off and withholding require governing-regime profiles and primary-source verification.
UBL, FIBO, ODRL, LegalRuleML and ISO/IEC 19086 are alignment targets only, not conformance claims.
Canonical package and live verification remain held.
